text:
zoe-sec: Alert from discovery scan: CI artifact in partner staging contains `vault:transit:` metadata plus a file named `agent-keystore.meta` that references KMS key version 3 (deprecated binding). Likely from an old local dev backup.

ben-oncall: Path? I'll start containment.

zoe-sec: s3://partner-staging-ci/artifacts/ci-build-2026-06-01.tar.gz
zoe-sec: artifact has `agent-keystore.meta` and `agent-sa.json.enc` (wrapped). The SA file appears wrapped but metadata points to a KMS version that we rotated off last year.

anya-eng: Risk: partner could have retained artifact. If their environment has access to old KMS grants, they might unwrap offline. We need to assume KEK exposure until proven otherwise.

morgan-devops: Immediate steps I can take:
```
# 1) restrict bucket read to partner CI principal only
aws s3api put-bucket-acl --bucket partner-staging-ci --grant-read ""
# 2) revoke any service account keys we find in the artifact
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete PLACEHOLDER --iam-account=agent-ci@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

ben-oncall: Done revoke on keys we found. Also disabled the partner CI role for object reads. Added temporary IAM condition blocking objects with prefix `ci-build-` until clearance.

security-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0601. Severity: medium. Assigned: zoe-sec, morgan-devops, anya-eng.

zoe-sec: We should rotate the KEK in KMS and re-encrypt Vault transit wrapping keys referencing that KEK. Anya, can you run a quick inventory of Vault paths with metadata pointing at the legacy key?

anya-eng: On it. Running `vault list -format=json metadata/` then grep for key version id. Will post list in thread.

audit-bot: Configured audit export for incident: gs://redwood-security/INC-2026-0601/. Exporting Vault audit and KMS admin logs.

morgan-devops: Plan:
1) Create new KMS key version and update key policy to remove legacy grants.
2) Update `vault-proxy` role to use new key version.
3) Dry-run `vault operator rewrap` for affected transit keys.
4) Canary rewrap on a single autocluster instance and run smoke inference test.
5) Full rewrap + rotate SA keys we revoked earlier.

anya-eng: Inventory complete: 4 transit key aliases reference legacy KEK (secret/transit/agents, secret/transit/ingest, secret/transit/caches, secret/transit/ci). Sharing object list in audit bucket.

morgan-devops: Opening infra PR to create cryptoKeyVersion and apply new grant only to `vault-proxy@infra-sa`. Will include a rollback that rebinds previous version for 15m if regressions detected.

zoe-sec: RBAC mitigation: temporarily block token creation for the `ci-agent` role and deny `vault:transit:encrypt` to all non-infra service accounts until rotation complete.

ben-oncall: Communicated to SRE: fallback routing to hosted inference tier is available if any agent-side decrypt fails during rotation window. We'll monitor latencies.

partner-ops: We're searching for retained copies; we will scrub any artifacts we control and provide deletion attestation. ETA 2 hours. Legal cc'd.

morgan-devops: Dry-run rewrap scheduled in 20m. Canary window 30m. Will stream rewrap logs to gs://redwood-security/INC-2026-0601/logs/.

anya-eng: After rewrap, run Redwood Optimize tokenization/regression job overnight to validate outputs unchanged. Also run a quick consistency check: decrypt->encrypt roundtrip on canary.

audit-bot: Audit log export in progress. Retention tag set per compliance request.

zoe-sec: Owners: zoe-sec (coord + partner), morgan-devops (infra + rewrap job), anya-eng (inventory + tests), ben-oncall (RBAC + monitoring), compliance-team (attestation retention). Will update incident checklist and close only after deletion attestation, audit export, and regtest pass. :white_check_mark:
